'''Cavyzap''' is a [[Lightning]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves into [[Hippiehog]] at 6 bronze stars/19 copies.

==Overview==
Current Description: "Cavyzap has always been extremely insecure and is never seen outside the cage. But don't be mistaken--the cage isn't a prison but a safehouse. As long as the house is there, Cavyzap isn't afraid to give passing [[Zobos]] the stink eye."

Cavyzap is a purple rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
Cavyzap is a brown rodent (most likely a guinea pig) with long, flowing, blond hair. It sits in a tiny cage and has tears in its eyes.

Cavyzap's [[Tatari#Glitter Tataris|Glitter]] form changes the color of its cage to dark green.

== Evolution Trial ==
Cavyzap's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 6 bronze stars/19 copies. To evolve it into [[Hippiehog]] you need to complete the following task:

* Kill 300 Zobos while clearing stages. Cavyzap wants to feel safe!

== Trivia ==
* Cavyzap and its evolutions were added to the game on 8/12/2026 alongside [[Technocan]] and [[Blastniff]].
* Cavyzap’s name is a combination of “cavy”, another name for a guinea pig or from caviidae, and “zap”.
